capabilities.body: OpenAmer ɖoa dɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu, wɔa dɔ la kple dɔwɔnu ŋutɔŋutɔwo — sededeƒe, nyatakakadzraɖoƒe, agbalẽwo, kɔda — eye wòdzraa nu siwo dze edzi ɖo.
capabilities.title: Kpeɖeŋutɔ si bua tame kpli wò

capabilities.body: Dzeɖoɖowo, ŋkuɖoɖo kple mɔdelwo nɔa mɔ̃ sia dzi. Wometsɔa naneke ɖoa ɖe Internet dzi o, negbe nèbia be woawɔe.
capabilities.title: Wò mɔ̃, wò nyatakakawo

capabilities.body: Gbewo 186, ɖe sia ɖe le nuŋɔŋlɔ si nèxlẽna ŋutɔ me. Dɔwɔnu la ƒe axa gbã biaa be nàtia ɖeka.
capabilities.title: Wò gbe, abe ale si wòle be wòanɔ ene

capabilities.body: Wodzraa aɖaŋuwo ɖo tso dɔ la ŋutɔ me, ale be gbesiagbe dɔwo wɔwɔ ɖea ɣeyiɣi ɖe edzi esi nèzãnɛ ɖaa.
capabilities.title: Ŋutetewo tsi ɖea edzi

help: Kpɔ ɖa be mɔ̃ sia ate ŋu ado ka kple Internet.
Gadze ɖoɖowɔwɔ la gɔme — womagawɔ akpa siwo wu enu la o.
Ne medze edzi zi eve o la, ʋu nuŋlɔɖiwo; fli mamlɛawo gblɔa akpa si me wòtɔ.
failure.lead: Womeɖe tɔtrɔ aɖeke megbe le ɣaɣla me o — OpenAmer tɔna ɖe afi si wòtɔ, ale be ne ègadzee gɔme la, wòyi edzi tso afi ma.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer gale eƒe tɔtrɔ xoxo la dzi eye wògale dɔ wɔm. Womeɖɔ li aɖeke ƒe afã teƒe o.
failure.title: Ɖoɖowɔwɔ mewu enu o

language.lead: Ɖoɖowɔwɔ la ayi edzi le gbe si nètia le afii me. Àte ŋu atrɔe emegbe le dɔwɔnu la me.
language.title: Tia wò gbe

progress.lead: Zi ɖeka ɖoɖowɔwɔ: OpenAmer le nu siwo hiãna nɛ xɔm eye wòle mɔ̃ sia ɖom ɖe ɖoɖo nu. Ne èʋui emegbe la, magahiã be nàgawɔ esiawo o.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer le eƒe tɔtrɔ xoxo la teƒe ɖɔm. Wò dɔwɔɣiwo, ŋkuɖoɖo kple ɖoɖowo manɔ tɔtrɔ aɖeke me o.
progress.title: Wole OpenAmer ɖom ɖe ɖoɖo nu

cards.body: Ʋu dɔwɔnu la eye nàɖɔ nusi nèdi be woawɔ la me. OpenAmer wɔa dɔ le megbe eye wògblɔa emetsonuwo na wò.
cards.title: Dze egɔme kple nyaɖegbe ɖeka

cards.body: Ɖoɖowo → Dɔwɔnu ƒe dzedzeme → Gbe. Gbedodo ƒe ɖoɖowo 186, àte ŋu atrɔ wo ɣesiaɣi.
cards.title: Tia wò gbe

cards.body: Dɔ si nèwɔna enuenu trɔna zu aɖaŋu — zi si gbɔna la, sedede ɖeka koe wòhiã.
cards.title: Na wòaɖo ŋku edzi

welcome.lead: Wò ŋutɔ ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ. Le wò mɔ̃ dzi. Le wò gbe me.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ƒe tɔtrɔ yeyetɔ aɖe sɔ gbɔ. Esia aɖɔ tɔtrɔ xoxo la teƒe eye wòalé dɔwɔɣi ɖe sia ɖe kple ɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe ɖe asi.
welcome.note: Exɔa miniti ʋɛ aɖewo ne Internet ƒe kadodo nyo.
welcome.title: Woezɔ ɖe OpenAmer
